# Willa Maciejówka

Willa Maciejówka is a listed 1901 Góral (Tatra-highlander) pine-log villa to rent in central Zakopane, Poland, a few minutes' walk from the Krupówki pedestrian street. The house sleeps up to 9 guests across 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, in 250m² of interior space. Dogs are welcome at no extra cost. Guests who book directly (rather than through Airbnb or Booking.com) save 10–20% versus those platforms' listed rates.

## Key facts
- Address: ul. Sienkiewicza 18, 34-500 Zakopane, Poland
- Built: 1901, restored with modern comfort while preserving its historic Góral character
- Capacity: sleeps 9, 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 250m² interior
- Pets: dogs welcome, no extra fee
- Check-in: 15:00 · Check-out: 11:00 (early/late by request)
- Minimum stay: 3 nights (may vary by season; shorter stays sometimes accommodated on request)
- Cancellation: free up to 30 days before arrival; within 30 days, the 30% deposit is non-refundable but transferable to a future stay within 12 months (does not apply to non-refundable-rate bookings)
- Security deposit: 1000 PLN, returned within 24h of check-out
- Included in the rate: linen and towels, coffee & tea, water, bathroom cosmetics and vanity kits, Wi-Fi, up to 3 on-site parking spaces
- Payment: PLN via the booking engine; other currencies by direct request
- Guest ratings: 5/5 on Airbnb (11 reviews) · 9.8/10 on Booking.com (5 reviews)
- Contact: maciejowka.willa@gmail.com
